dedupe_keys.name: experimental data for validation of a single storey flexible double skin facade model twins test cell torino

description: This dataset contains experimental measurements used to validate a building energy simulation model of a flexible double-skin façade module, an adaptive envelope that can switch between cavity ventilation strategies and interact with heating, cooling and ventilation systems. It was published on Zenodo on 14 October 2022 by Elena Catto Lucchino and Francesco Goia of NTNU (Trondheim), Giovanni Gennaro of EURAC Research (Bolzano) and Fabio Favoino of Politecnico di Torino. The data come from a dedicated campaign in one of the outdoor test cells of the TWINS facility in Torino, Italy, and were compared with a new model built on the Double Glass Facade component of IDA ICE; the prediction accuracy was in line with that component's performance for conventional double-skin façades. Coverage is a single-storey façade module in one test cell. Access: one ZIP of about 2.5 MB on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: the variable list and sampling interval are only in the files, which were not opened. Simulation uses: validation of adaptive façade models in building energy simulation and of envelope retrofit options. Related records: the timber-framed wall hygrothermal measurements and the BIM4EEB sensor data.
